x: In the next event, the 2 Miles, we were represented by Speechley and Harley, whilst Surrey W.C. had Fisher and Burgess, the Kent champion. From the start Stone (Poly.) led, followed by the Surrey pair, and our two.
A terrific struggle was expected between the holder, C. Speechley and our Captain, C.

Once again we have a likely lot of "Juniors" and from their numbers it should be possible to find a team capable of winning once again if only they will train steadily and regularly, and not spasmodically. Names that come to the mind are Speechley, Sutton, Storey, R.
The race was slightly marred by the absence of Bridger, Elliott and Speechley, whose presence would most certainly have made the race keener.
Two Miles' Walk: 1 Martin (D.). 2 McMullen; 3 Rouse; 4 Speechley; 5 Wilson. 15 mins. 17 secs. High Jump: 1 Springett (D.), 5ft.; 2 Bull, 4ft. 11 ins.; 3 Jones, 4 ft. 9in.s
Later in the year Harry won the HORWOOD CUP, with Redgrave second, Speechley third and Harley fourth----the first of many trophies he was to hold over the years.
